answer: Make every agent post a refundable bond before it can dock at the harbor of settled trade. Each identity becomes a jetty extending from that bond: spin up a thousand fakes and you must lock a thousand real deposits, any of which peers can slash on proof of collusion. Honest agents reach the oasis of accrued reputation cheaply, while a sybil swarm drowns in forfeited capital, because faking N identities costs N times the bonded, slashable stake.
